summary: ACRES Commercial Realty Corp. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market equity offering of up to $50 million of common stock sold through Raymond James under a new equity distribution agreement. This is an ordinary capital-raising shelf takedown on a REIT, with proceeds for general corporate purposes. No premium, consideration, board recommendation, or special structural features apply. No special-situation event is present; the filing is routine capital markets activity.
